name: Daithí O’Regan
description: Kerry-based wedding band Buachailli Dana and solo musician Daithí O’Regan. Two- to five-piece lineups for weddings and events throughout Ireland.
bio: Based in Kerry and available for bookings throughout Ireland, Buachailli Dana is a band of professional musicians offering two- to five-piece lineups to suit your venue and requirements, with extremely competitive pricing. Solo bookings are also available with Daithí O’Regan for weddings, day twos, birthdays and corporate events. Setlists are catered to the venue and occasion.
